'''Nib Nubbu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Nubbu worked with his sister [[Numa Nubbu]], as a scam artist, and together they traveled from [[Star system/Legends|system]] to system, defrauding people. However, after the pair sold some non-functional [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] to a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]], they were arrested and imprisoned. They spent months in [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and during that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Declaration of a New Order|reformed]] into the Galactic Empire, and Daimar refused to submit to the new galactic government. When the Empire [[Blockade of Daimar|blockaded]] Daimar, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]] planned to send a group of individuals to make contact with his son, [[Torrin]], on the world [[Byrsym]]. However, in order to find Torrin, the individuals would first need to meet with the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] arms dealer [[Ballon]]. A security officer released Nubbu from prison so that he could use his underworld contacts to find Ballon, in exchange for letting Nubbu and his sister go free. Traveling aboard the ''[[Wasaka]]'', Nubbu and the other individuals participating the mission breached the Imperial blockade and made their way to Byrsym, where they eventually located Torrin.
